checkpoint_policy.concurrency_rule: Re-read the state before work. Skip while another unexpired run lease exists. Acquire the lease in a committed state update and re-read before every later write.
checkpoint_policy.interruption_rule: Resume only from a completed stage boundary. Reconcile pending or uncertain external actions before replaying them.
checkpoint_policy.usage_limit_rule: If safe writing remains possible, set retry_waiting, preserve next_action, record the blocker and release the lease. Otherwise leave the last valid checkpoint untouched for the hourly retry.
checkpoint_policy.duplicate_rule: Check the checkpoint, repository records, intended artifacts and live destination before publication or delivery.
checkpoint_policy.routine_approval: Continue without routine editorial approval when authorized; stop for confirmations required by the platform.
